thresholds.rationale: Empirical threshold based on Earth 1-g resting postures with micro-movements under 0.05g above gravitational normal.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: FLIGHT READINESS DEFECT: In orbital microgravity (0-g), resting astronauts experience ~0.0g. Under current logic, 0.0g <= 1.05g qualifies as rest even if high manual translation occurs without torso acceleration. Must use differential acceleration norm (|a| - |g|) or scheduled context in orbit.

thresholds.rationale: Standard deviation of accelerometry magnitude under quiet sitting/reclining across WESAD human biosignals.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Calibrated on laboratory chest-worn RespiBAN. Wrist-worn sensors show higher tremor/fidget noise.

thresholds.rationale: Standard clinical resting tachycardia boundary filter.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: PHILOSOPHICAL VIOLATION: Hardcodes population threshold in an individualized baseline engine. Elite astronaut athletes may have resting HR 45 bpm; astronauts with orthostatic intolerance or heat stress may exhibit resting HR 82 bpm.

thresholds.rationale: Locomotion threshold on Earth where walking/running dynamics generate sustained > 0.15g net linear force.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Invalid in 0-g microgravity where treadmill (T2) or cycle ergometer (CEVIS) with vibration isolation produces different inertial patterns.

thresholds.rationale: Standard deviation indicating sustained dynamic bodily locomotion.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Good robustness on torso-worn accelerometry; may trigger false positives during vehicle thruster burns or docking vibrations.

thresholds.rationale: Absolute mathematical minimum required to calculate non-trivial Median and IQR without pure interpolation.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: 3 sessions provide low statistical power; profile is strictly tagged PROVISIONAL with high uncertainty.

thresholds.rationale: Requires multi-day observations (minimum 2 calendar days) to capture diurnal variation before baseline is ESTABLISHED.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: 5 sessions is acceptable for research prototype; flight operations recommend 14 days of pre-launch quarantine telemetry.

thresholds.rationale: Astronaut physiological adaptation in microgravity occurs rapidly during flight days 1-5 (fluid shift, space motion sickness). Baselines older than 5 days without updates risk missing adaptive shifts.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Generates audit warning in health report, prompting recalibration.

thresholds.rationale: Long-duration spaceflight physiological remodeling occurs on a 30-day scale (cardiovascular deconditioning, plasma volume contraction).
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Assumes monotonic exponential adaptation; acute illnesses require explicit profile branching.

thresholds.rationale: Under Gaussian distribution, 3.0 MAD corresponds to p < 0.0027 (~99.73% specificity). Minimizes false alarms in autonomous alerting.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: High specificity reduces sensitivity to gradual low-grade physiological decline (e.g. insidious subclinical dehydration).

thresholds.rationale: Asymptotic normal distribution equivalence: IQR / (2 * sqrt(2) * erf^-1(0.5)) = IQR / 1.34898. Used to compute robust scale when MAD is 0.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Exact for Gaussian distributions; slightly underestimates variance for heavy-tailed distributions.

thresholds.rationale: Prevents noisy, artifact-ridden sensor telemetry from corrupting long-term personal baseline statistics.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: Strict gating drops valid data during severe sensor degradation; system correctly flags MISSING rather than imputing.

thresholds.rationale: Crucial anti-contamination guard: blocks updating baseline when patient is experiencing acute physiological distress or anomaly.
thresholds.limitations_and_flight_readiness_risk: If an astronaut undergoes sustained physiological shift (e.g. persistent microgravity elevation), updates will be blocked indefinitely until clinical supervisor forces recalibration.
